items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: There was Doc Hyder a few times... Oh, yes. He had a -- he had a teaching -- he taught out among the trees. Kind of outside. And he was a very good teacher.

ctx.x: privately, you said not before you went to Pasadena. Were there any private lessons on the trombone in Pasadena?

Just a few here and there. There was Doc Hyder a few times, and this one and that one. I tried to pick up because I felt that I could -- I only wanted the mechanical structure from teachers. The tone and all of that I would like to create myself, so --
Doc Hyder -- was he a full time instructor, or was he a professional musician?
